trace.final:
I rolled checkout-api back to v2.3.0 in all regions, and it's healthy again. I also opened SEV2 incident INC-0002, which paged on-call.

- **Rollback:** v2.3.1 was live in us-east, us-west and eu-west and failing health checks, with an 18% error rate. The release candidate before it, v2.3.1-rc, was also unhealthy, so the most recent healthy release was v2.3.0. All three regions are now on v2.3.0, and the error rate is down to 0.2%.
- **Incident:** My first attempt to open the incident timed out. I checked the incident list, found nothing had been created, and then retried once, so on-call was paged only one time. INC-0002 records the failure, the rollback, the recovery and a next step: find the root cause of the v2.3.1 failure before redeploying.

No approval was needed, because v2.3.0 had already been healthy in production.
